GridBox / LineGridScene
|-- LineGridScene: { contents, root }
|   |-- contents: Readonly<Record<string, Diagram>>
|   `-- root: GridBox
|       |-- Boxes reference content; the controller manages scene changes.
|       |-- id; position: GridPoint; minimumSize?; collapsed; collapsedContentId?
|       `-- kind: 'diagram' | 'container'
|           |-- diagram: contentId
|           `-- Containers retain child placement and a push-right layout policy.
|               `-- children: readonly GridBox[]; layout: { collisionPolicy, gap }
|-- Cells are zero-based; right and bottom bounds are exclusive.
`-- Scene computations
    |-- resolveScene(scene): ResolvedGridBox
    |   |-- Measures ASCII and expanded descendants without mutating input.
    |   `-- Collapsed boxes require summary content and omit expanded children.
    |-- updateGridBox(scene, id, update): LineGridScene
    |   `-- Produces an immutable edit; layoutScene commits resulting positions.
    |-- layoutScene(scene, changedId): LineGridScene
    |   `-- Anchors the changed subtree at each ancestor.
    |       |-- Settles siblings in stable order by moving only right.
    |       `-- composeScene(next) validates final bounds and collisions.
    |-- composeScene(scene, renderContent?): string
    |-- hitTest(scene, point) returns the deepest matching box and local cell.
    `-- projectMapping(bounds, mapping): GridBounds
